hooks.name: ClimateTwin dashboard tests
hooks.description: Run dashboard tests when dashboard code changes. Enable in Phase 14.

hooks.name: ClimateTwin dashboard artifact audit
hooks.description: Review dashboard changes for artifact integrity and scientific labeling. Enable in Phase 14.

action.prompt: Review the just-saved ClimateTwin dashboard code. Review only; do not modify files in this hook. Verify that the UI consumes saved manifest-linked artifacts rather than retraining models, marks unavailable experiments clearly instead of using placeholders, uses dynamic scenario controls derived from actual configured features, displays per-variable metrics with correct units, shows the mandatory non-causal scenario disclaimer, and does not overstate Aurora/CREDIT reproduction or model performance. Browser-level Playwright validation should remain an explicit Phase 14 task, not an automatic file-save action.
